newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Aug. 30 foreign reserves at $8.059 bln.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Aug. 30 foreign reserves at $8.059 bln.

text.p: Colombia's net foreign reserves as of Aug. 30 totalled $8.059 billion, up $5.1 million from Aug. 23, according to official central bank figures.
Between January and Aug. 30, the figures show that Colombia's net reserves have dropped $265.5 million.
The country's net reserves as of Aug. 30 1995 totalled $8.281 billion. -- Javier Mozzo, Bogota newsroom, 571 610 7944
